mana speed, which is his primary claim to fame. He’s designed as a disruptor who softens up the enemy team with a mix of direct damage, elemental defense down, and damage over time (DoT).

While he looks like a terrifying, blue-flamed demon robot (and let's be honest, who doesn't love a good angry blue robot?), his role is less about nuking the enemy into oblivion and more about being a persistent, icy thorn in their side.

Skarn's design is a striking mix of mechanical precision and elemental chaos. He looks like someone took a classic fantasy golem and upgraded it with futuristic blue LEDs and a bad attitude. The "Balefrost" theme is evident in the blue flames wreathing his metallic frame. It’s a cool, aggressive look that stands out, even if he does look a bit like he’s judging your puzzle-matching skills.

The community reaction to Skarn was... lukewarm.

However, defenders of the Construct argue:

The consensus? A great support piece, but not a star.

Skarn is the ultimate "wingman." He's not the guy who buys the drinks (the healer) or the guy who starts the fight (the tank), but he's the one who holds the opponent's arms behind their back so your heavy hitter can punch them in the nose. In the modern era of Empires & Puzzles, his stats are showing their age, but his utility—specifically that delicious Very Fast Elemental Defense Down—keeps him from the scrap heap.
A solid B-Tier hero that shines in specific offensive formations and Titan teams. Keep him polished, but maybe don't marry him.
